profile: Mac Companion local XPC Interactive admission transport v0.1

publication.selectedDisplayID: optional opaque UUID scoped to the visible menu-process generation

rules: same-team exact-role authentication and accepted menu readiness are required before publication
the first publication for a transport generation has revision 1 and every replacement increments exactly once
a replay is accepted only when the complete command exactly matches the retained command
the menu-process UUID remains constant for one transport generation and must change for a replacement process
selectedDisplayID is nil when no display is selected and is never a CGDirectDisplayID or other physical identifier
request and success payloads are nonempty closed canonical JSON no larger than 4096 bytes
transport replacement or loss immediately withdraws the matching visible admission without accepting stale invalidation
timeout, cancellation after send, malformed traffic, unknown fields, correlation mismatch, and concurrent publication terminate the generation
publication grants no Observe, Act, Control, capture, input, media, route, pairing, or credential authority
